queries: WITH eq AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_h FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref HAVING AVG(humepct) IS NOT NULL), allavg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_h) AS a FROM eq), grp AS (SELECT eq.equipref, eq.avg_h, allavg.a FROM eq CROSS JOIN allavg WHERE eq.avg_h > allavg.a), gm AS (SELECT AVG(avg_h) AS m FROM grp) SELECT grp.equipref, grp.avg_h AS avg_humidity, grp.avg_h - grp.a AS excess_over_all_avg, grp.avg_h - gm.m AS diff_from_group_mean FROM grp CROSS JOIN gm WHERE grp.a IS NOT NULL AND gm.m IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The 'average across all equipment' is the mean of the per-equipment average humidities, so each equipment counts equally. Equipment with no non-null humidity readings has no average and is left out.
Equipment are identified by scanenvironment.equipref, and the equipment table is not needed.
The 'difference from the group mean' is the equipment's average humidity minus the mean of the above-average equipment's averages. Ranking by it gives the same order as ranking by average humidity.

alternatives.interpretation: The all-equipment average is the plain average of every humidity reading, so equipment with more readings weigh more. The rest of the logic is the same.

assumptions.assumption: The 'average across all equipment' is the mean of the per-equipment average humidities, so each equipment counts equally. Equipment with no non-null humidity readings is excluded.

The 'mean of the above-average group' is the mean of those equipment's average humidities. 'Difference from the group mean' is the equipment's average minus that mean, and the ranking uses this value.

alternatives.interpretation: The all-equipment average is the pooled average of every non-null humidity reading in scanenvironment, so equipment with more readings weigh more. Equipment is still compared by its own average.

assumptions.assumption: The 'average across all equipment' is the mean of the per-equipment average humidities, so each equipment counts equally. Equipment with no non-null humidity readings is excluded.
Equipment is identified by scanenvironment.equipref. Only equipment that has environment records is considered.
'Difference from the group mean' is the equipment's average minus the mean of the per-equipment averages in the above-average group. It can be negative. Results are sorted by this value, descending.

alternatives.interpretation: The all-equipment average is the average over all individual humidity readings (weighted by reading count), not the mean of per-equipment averages.
